explication: Backhaul is a reverse-tunneling application with client and server roles. The main workflow loads TOML configuration, selects a role and transport, then establishes tunnel connections that carry traffic between configured local ports and the remote side. The README also documents UDP forwarding, multiplexing, WebSocket/TLS transports, traffic monitoring, and configuration reload. Transport internals are only partly excerpted, so links inferred solely from the source index are limited to its recorded module references.
